part.text:
All 8 tests pass, including the new `NO_COLOR` checks in `tests/shtest`.

The fix (src/execute.c:1058): `jq_set_colors()` now skips the automatic tty-based coloring when `NO_COLOR` is set to a non-empty value, following the https://no-color.org/ convention:

- `NO_COLOR` unset → colors on when stdout is a tty (unchanged)
- `NO_COLOR=` (empty) → colors still on
- `NO_COLOR=1` → colors suppressed
- `NO_COLOR=1 jq -C` → colors still on, since explicit `-C` is applied after this check in main.c:578
